translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
qasam hai injeer aur zaitoon ki ,
aur sehraye seena kay pahar toor ki ,
aur iss aman o aman walay shehar ki ,
kay hum ney insan ko behtareen sanchay mein dhaal ker peda kiya hai ,
phir hum ussay pasti walon mein sabb say ziyada nichli halat mein ker-detay hain ,
siwaye unn kay jo emaan laye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye , to unn ko aisa ajar milay ga jo kabhi khatam nahi hoga .
phir ( aey insan ! ) woh kiya cheez hai jo tujhay jaza o saza ko jhutlaney per aamada ker rahi hai ?
kiya Allah saray hukmranon say barh ker hukmran nahi hai ?
